x.note: Distance from the centre line, outward; a centre feature uses it as plain x.

round.note: Corner exponent: 1 a diamond, 2 an ellipse, 4 and up a rounded box.

lid.note: Upper lid: 0 open, 1 shut. Shut matter gathers on the lid line.

lidTilt.note: Upper lid slant: positive drops the inner end (a glare), negative the outer (worry).

lidBow.note: Upper lid curve: positive sags in the middle, negative arches.

lowTilt.note: Lower lid slant: positive raises the inner end.

lowBow.note: Lower lid curve: positive rises in the middle (a smiling eye).

hollow.note: Empty middle: 0 filled, toward 1 a ring.

rings.note: Its matter gathered into this many rings, from the middle out: 0 filled, 3 a loudspeaker.

slats.note: Its matter gathered into this many bars across: 0 filled, 5 a grille.

mesh.note: Its matter gathered into dots, this many across the middle, inside a rim: 0 filled, 10 a speaker cover.

globe.note: Its matter set as dots on a ball seen from the side, this many rows from pole to pole, with a few grains in orbit: 0 flat, 9 an orb.

spin.note: How fast a globe turns, in turns a second. What it has turned is kept, so a change of speed never jumps it.

stir.note: How much a globe is stirred: its rows slide past each other, its axis wanders and its orbits quicken.

loose.note: How far a globe has lost its shape: 0 a ball, 1 a lump that bulges, its dots frayed and some of its matter strayed.

turn.note: Rotation in degrees, mirrored across the face.

share.note: Its share of the matter; matter flows between features as shares change.

face.squash.note: Positive squashes flat and wide, negative stretches tall.

matter.cohesion.note: How tightly matter holds its shape: 1 crisp, 0 a loose cloud.

matter.hue.note: Colour, in degrees away from its own.

emit.left.note: Arcs leaving the left side of the face, as sound leaves a loudspeaker: 0 none, 1 all of them.

auto.blink.note: How often it blinks unasked; 0 never.

auto.saccade.note: How much its gaze flicks unasked.

sound.level.note: How loud what the page is playing is, now. 0 while nothing plays.

sound.low.note: The low end of it: the body of a voice, a bass.

sound.mid.note: The middle of it: vowels, most of a voice.

sound.high.note: The top of it: consonants, hiss.

sound.beat.note: Jumps to 1 when a sound sets in (a syllable, a beat) and dies away in about a fifth of a second.

run.pace.note: How busy the run is with tools: each call that starts or ends pushes it up, and it dies away in a few seconds. 0 while nothing runs.

run.effort.note: The reasoning effort the run was asked for, least 0 to most 1, the middle where none was. 0 while nothing runs.

run.context.note: How full the conversation is past 400,000 tokens: 0 up to there, 1 at the model's window (a million where it is not known). 0 while nothing runs, and where the window is no larger than that.

body.speed.note: How fast the figure is moving on the page: 0 still, 1 as fast as it is thrown.
